coverage_caveat: A station listed as a market affiliate does not guarantee reception at a specific address or that it will carry every event. AM/FM reception depends on signal, antenna, local pre-emption and broadcast rights. No individual Westwood One game is claimed to air on a named station unless the station listing supports that network carriage.
